name: print-social-lime-and-indigo-consulting-carousel
title: Lime and indigo consulting carousel with bubble bullets
whatItIs: A lime green background with an Instagram phone at left showing a post 'How We Help You Unlock It' and six square posts at right. Each has an indigo arch or circle shape, a cut-out professional, bold headline, and lime pills with plus icons as bullet points.
whatItMeans: Energetic, trustworthy and educational; consistent shapes make a service feel systematic.
techniques: Use big indigo curves that cut across a white card as a repeating device.
Turn bullets into pill labels with plus icons.
Highlight one keyword in a lime block.
Cut people out and let them overlap the shape edges.

vocabulary.definition: A list item styled as a rounded label.
A large arc shape repeated across posts.
A person breaking the edge of a shape.
A set of posts sharing structure.
